description: This file contains interface definitions for stream provider runtime components and pub/sub system types within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It defines interfaces for managing streaming providers, pub/sub interactions, and related enumerations.
external_methods: IProviderRuntime: (methods not explicitly listed, as it's imported)
Task<T>: (generic task methods from Task class)

classes.name: StreamPubSubType
classes.description: Enumeration for different pub/sub system types used by stream providers.

methods.name: ExecutingEntityIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves the opaque identity of the currently executing grain or client object.

methods.name: PubSub
methods.description: Returns the pub/sub runtime interface for a given pub/sub type.

methods.name: InitializePullingAgents
methods.description: Starts the pulling agents for a persistent stream provider, given its name and associated adapter factory and adapter.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specific stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer for a specific stream subscription.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a specific stream subscription.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a given stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a given stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a new subscription identifier for a stream consumer.
